title.zh: 【日本瑞穗、三菱日联、三井住友银行公布日元稳定币共同发行实证结果】
title.en: 【日本瑞穗、三菱日联、三井住友银行公布日元稳定币共同发行实证结果】

current_state.zh: Mizuho, MUFG and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp published results of their joint yen stablecoin proof-of-concept, confirming the feasibility of a shared issuance model with MUFG Trust as trustee and validating cross-border issuance, transfer and redemption for Mitsubishi Corp, with plans for deposit-backed reserves and live transactions in FY2026.
current_state.en: Mizuho, MUFG and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp published results of their joint yen stablecoin proof-of-concept, confirming the feasibility of a shared issuance model with MUFG Trust as trustee and validating cross-border issuance, transfer and redemption for Mitsubishi Corp, with plans for deposit-backed reserves and live transactions in FY2026.
